entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Bob. How can I help you today?
Hi Bob, I'd like to make a return for a VeloBand I purchased.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Can I just get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Yes, the name is Jeanette Peters, and the order number is VF-881-5124.

Thank you, Jeanette. One moment... Okay, I see your account here. And, oh, I see you're one of our VIP members! Thank you for your loyalty. Looking at the purchase date, you are well within the 90 days for a return, so that is no problem at all.
Oh, wonderful. So I can just send it back for a full refund?
Absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label as we speak. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes.
That was incredibly easy. Thank you so much.

It's my pleasure! And as a small thank you for being a VIP member, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for you to use on a future purchase. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
Wow, you didn't have to do that! That's very kind. No, that's everything. Thank you again, Bob.
You are very welcome, Jeanette. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a fantastic day.
